snippets.snippet: CHAMPAIGN COUNTY BUILDING REGULATIONS HOW TO OBTAIN A PERMIT Step One Obtain Zoning Permit from city, township or village. Step Two Obtain Site Evaluation approval from Health Department. Step Three Obtain driveway permit & house number from Champaign County Engineering Department if property in on county or township roads. If property is on state highway, contact ODOT. If the property is located within a city or village, the house numbers are issued by local government. Step Four Obtain sewage disposal permit, plumbing permit and well permit from Champaign Health District. Step Five Apply for a building permit from the Champaign County Building Regulations Office. A. Completely fill out permit application. B. Submit copies of zoning permit & site evaluation approval. C. Submit two (2) sets of detailed plans for review and approval.
